description:
Mobile FeliCa Client (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.felicanetworks.mfm.main)
Essential app for using FeliCa.
Uninstalling this may occur errors to install this in apps which uses FeliCa. You can uninstall this if you don't use FeliCa-related services.
NOTE: Uninstalling this does not remove the data saved in FeliCa.
